title: Wayfare Rentals Mileage Allowance and Vehicle Use Terms
content:
Every Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) class includes a weekly mileage allowance and sets a charge for each mile beyond it. The allowance and the per-mile charge are set by vehicle class as follows.

## Schedule A: allowance and overage charge by class

| Vehicle class | Miles included per rental week | Charge per mile over the weekly allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | 1500 miles | $0.20 per mile |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | 1500 miles | $0.20 per mile |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | 1500 miles | $0.20 per mile |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | 1500 miles | $0.25 per mile |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | 1500 miles | $0.25 per mile |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | 1200 miles | $0.30 per mile |

## Schedule B: how miles are measured

The miles for a rental week are taken from the odometer readings at the week's start and end. Unused miles do not carry over: miles left inside one week's allowance are not added to the next week's allowance. This basis is the same for every class.

## Schedule C: use of the vehicle

| Term | Every Wayfare Rentals class |
|---|---|
| Personal driving within the mileage allowance | Allowed |
| Leaving the hub's state | Not allowed |
| Anyone other than the renter driving the vehicle | Not allowed |

## Questions on these terms

**Does a light week leave extra miles for the following week?** No. Each rental week has its own allowance from Schedule A, and unused miles do not carry over.

**Is the Premium Sedan allowance the same as the other classes?** No. The Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan includes 1200 miles per rental week; the other five classes include 1500 miles.

**May the renter use the vehicle off-platform?** Personal driving is allowed within the mileage allowance; the vehicle may not leave the hub's state, and only the renter may drive it.
